compiler_audit.24: R65 starts at 16 and increments by 16; P2 (next >= 64) suppresses eight lookahead loads, and P4 exits. The actual backedge is 0x1600 @!P4 BRA 0xc10. The loop contains seven static HMMA instructions and executes 28 active HMMA at parent K128.
compiler_audit.25: There is no K loop. The 28 static HMMA instructions represent seven independent C chains across four stages, with first C = RZ followed by three self-chain accumulations. The 32 static LDG.E.64 instructions represent four raw banks; there is no fifth bank.
compiler_audit.shared_arithmetic: All seven complete P products persist through increasing K stages 0/16/32/48. After all products, the fixed U epilogue uses 14 FADD instructions and four STG.E.64 instructions. This remains M1, not M2.
compiler_audit.lookahead: In variant24, the eighth lookahead LDG appears after the first HMMA. Some variant25 bank loads interleave product HMMA. Source prefetch placement does not prove that all next loads precede the seven MMA instructions.
compiler_audit.active_counts_at_k128: Variants24 and25 both execute 28 active HMMA and 32 active 64-bit raw loads at K128. The final eight loop-body load instructions in variant24 are predicated off. Static counts include NOP instructions and the terminal self-BRA.
compiler_audit.old19: Both original19 SASS address/instruction sequences are identical to the source25 compiled binary. All 21 older CUDA source files are byte unchanged.
compiler_audit.limits: Static counts and lower register counts do not establish dynamic issue, DRAM traffic, achieved occupancy or a latency mechanism. ncu was not retried.

interpretation: Neither variant24 nor25 crosses the 3% primary own-SW latency trigger against the observed minimum from source23. No new full performance suite was triggered. Historical full measurements versus current quick screens remain diagnostic, with selection, clock and submission caveats.

Each 18-row screen has two K128 native rows and 16 rows running the original19 fallback chain. All rows are finite and fail the numerical gate. Raw CSV retains the actual names. Only K128 is specialized; K256/512/1024 are not.

The same-row Dense latency is higher in the variant24 screen. Variant25 BF128 Dense 4.192 us / SW 4.0016 us = 1.0476; FP128 Dense 4.0800 us / SW 4.1344 us is below 1. Neither improves the historical own-SW minimum. These results do not complete the four-size goal, certify numerical accuracy or activate Auto.
